hero.titolo: Report what's happening in your neighborhood.
hero.sottotitolo: Crime App collects public safety reports on a shared map. Each report expires on its own once it's no longer useful.

fase1.titolo: Open the map and pick a spot
fase1.descrizione: Mark where the event happened and choose the most fitting category.

fase2.titolo: The report stays visible until it expires
fase2.descrizione: Each category has a validity period: once it's over, the report disappears on its own.

fase3.descrizione: Suspicious reports can be flagged and are reviewed by the platform's moderators.

footer.tagline: Crime App — public safety reports maintained by the community.

posizione.negata: Location not shared, so the map shows a default area. You can turn it on in your browser settings.
posizione.nonDisponibile: We can't detect your location, so the map shows a default area.

segnalazioni.errore: We can't load reports right now. Move the map to try again.

conferma.chiusa: Report closed: several people said it's no longer happening.
conferma.errore: We couldn't record your answer. Try again.

soccorsi.testo: 112 is the single emergency number for police, fire brigade and ambulance. Call it if someone is in danger.
soccorsi.daComputer: You can't call from a computer: dial 112 on your phone.

nuova.categorieNonDisponibili: Categories aren't available right now. Try again shortly.
nuova.descrizionePlaceholder: What did you see, and where exactly?
nuova.anonimaAiuto: Your name won't be shown to other people.
nuova.errore: We couldn't post your report. Check your connection and try again.

scarto.testo: What you've entered will be lost.

posizione.istruzione: Press and hold the pin, then drag it to the exact spot.
